claude.sample_unit: patient education materials (25 original PEMs plus AI-translated versions)

links.outcome: Readability of original AAFPRS patient education materials versus 6th-grade standard
links.effect: Original PEMs had mean FKGL 10.7, GFI 13.48, and FKRE 50.8, exceeding the recommended level; AI-translated versions improved to FKGL 8.41, GFI 10.62, FKRE 64.43 (p<0.001), still above 6th grade.
links.quote: Original PEMs had a mean FKGL, GFI, and FKRE of 10.7, 13.48, and 50.8 respectively, which exceed the recommended level.

links.outcome: Reading level of patient education materials and AI-simplified versions
links.effect: Original PEMs exceeded recommended level (FKGL 10.7); AI-generated PEMs improved readability (FKGL 8.41, p<0.001) but did not reach the 6th-grade target.
links.quote: The translated AI-generated PEMs had a mean FKGL, GFI, and FKRE of 8.41, 10.62, and 64.43 respectively, representing an improvement in readability (p < 0.001).

unlisted_practices: Using generative AI to rewrite patient education materials to a lower reading level
